segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including sun-damaged dry skin on the calves, report the cream absorbs well and relieves dryness, with one buying a second tube.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive or highly sensitive, acne-prone skin report the cream soothed and helped repair their skin without irritation.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry or winter-dry skin report the cream hydrates, restores, and protects, becoming a daily moisturizer used in smaller amounts once skin improved.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report using this specifically for a broken or damaged skin barrier, including damage from retinol, and describe it as soothing and helping repair the barrier over about a month of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with congested, broken-out, acne-prone skin reports the cream helped soothe her skin barrier while keeping skin moisturized, with no mention of new breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under makeup and sunscreen

extraits.texte: I mean this wholeheartedly when i say this moisturizer saved my dry skin. Worth the price, no oil residue, no stickiness, and not heavy. Saved my skin, get it if youre thinking about it!

extraits.titre: PLS buy if your skin barrier is broken

As someone with highly sensitive acne prone skin, I could not recommend this enough! A little goes a longggg way btw

extraits.texte: I have very dry sun damaged skin on my calves that has been an issue for several years. This absorbs really well and seems to be improving my damaged skin. Buying a second tube!!

I caused some bad barrier damage woth retinol and couldn't find anything thqt was helping. This product helped me repair it and i will be regularly using this moving forward. My skin looks and feels amazing after use.

reserve: Only six reviews are available, all positive (4 stars or above), so no critical or dissenting perspective could be included and conclusions rest on a very small sample.
